name: basic-api-server
description: A script that creates a basic HTTP server with a few API endpoints.

variants.javascript-no-comments: Write a JavaScript script that creates a basic HTTP server that listens on port 3000. The server should have two endpoints: `/` which returns "Hello, World!", and `/hello` which returns a JSON object `{"message": "Hello, stranger!"}`. The script should not have any comments.

The script should include inline comments to explain the logic.

testCases.test: const http = require('http'); const server = require('./basic-api-server.js'); const options = {hostname: 'localhost', port: 3000, path: '/', method: 'GET'}; const req = http.request(options, res => { let data = ''; res.on('data', d => { data += d; }); res.on('end', () => { console.assert(data === 'Hello, World!', '/ should return Hello, World!'); server.close(); }); }); req.on('error', error => { console.error(error); server.close(); }); req.end();

const http = require('http'); const server = require('./basic-api-server.js'); const options = {hostname: 'localhost', port: 3000, path: '/hello', method: 'GET'}; const req = http.request(options, res => { let data = ''; res.on('data', d => { data += d; }); res.on('end', () => { const expected = JSON.stringify({message: 'Hello, stranger!'}); console.assert(data === expected, '/hello should return {message: "Hello, stranger!"}'); server.close(); }); }); req.on('error', error => { console.error(error); server.close(); }); req.end();
